name: Common Origin design tokens
description: How the token sets and modes combine, in the DTCG 2025.10 Resolver format (decision 0032). config/style-dictionary.config.mjs builds tokens.json, tokens.ts and the :root block of tokens.css from the sets, and a [data-co-density] block in tokens.css for each density context.

density.description: Control heights and control insets for a region, set with data-co-density on any element (decisions 0032 and 0034, #191). Rows and layout spacing don't change.
